title: IMB16-5 alleviates liver fibrosis by targeting MICALL2/beta-catenin signaling.
authors: Ge, Mao-Xu; Liu, Dong; Liu, Ting-Chao; Lu, Zhen-Ning; Zhang, Na; Li, Yi-Ming; Guo, Si-Min; Li, Yang; Liu, Yi-Chen; Wang, Ju-Xian; Shi, Yi-Kang; Wang, Yu-Cheng; He, Hong-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子IMB16-5靶向MICALL2/β-catenin信号缓解肝纤维化，核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与代谢调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver fibrosis, which is driven by activated hepatic stellate cells (HSCs), lacks approved therapies. Here, we identify MICAL-like protein 2 (MICALL2) as a novel therapeutic target and elucidate the antifibrotic mechanism of IMB16-5, a first-in-class arylsulfonylamino-benzanilide derivative. IMB16-5 significantly attenuated liver fibrosis in carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4))-injured mice by reducing collagen deposition, inflammation, and HSC activation. Using limited proteolysis-small-molecule mapping (LiP-SMap) and molecular dynamics simulation, we discovered that IMB16-5 binds to the C-terminal domain of MICALL2. Mechanistically, MICALL2 prevents beta-catenin from binding to GSK3beta, thereby shielding beta‑catenin from degradation and ultimately promoting Wnt signaling. IMB16-5 disrupts the MICALL2-beta-catenin interaction, which suppresses beta-catenin nuclear translocation. Consequently, IMB16-5 inhibits both glycolytic reprogramming and mitochondrial respiration in HSCs, promoting a quiescent phenotype. Further investigations revealed that HIF-1alpha acts downstream of the MICALL2/beta-catenin signalingto integrate metabolic-inflammatory crosstalk. Critically, MICALL2 overexpression in vivo abolishes the therapeutic efficacy of IMB16-5, confirming target engagement. Our work establishes MICALL2 as a druggable target for liver fibrosis and identifies IMB16-5 as a promising therapeutic candidate that acts through dual metabolic suppression.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化由活化的肝星状细胞（HSCs）驱动，目前缺乏获批疗法。在此，我们确定MICAL样蛋白2（MICALL2）为新型治疗靶点，并阐明IMB16-5（一种首创的芳基磺酰氨基苯甲酰苯胺衍生物）的抗纤维化机制。IMB16-5通过减少胶原沉积、炎症和HSC活化，显著减轻了四氯化碳（CCl(4)）损伤小鼠的肝纤维化。利用有限蛋白水解-小分子作图（LiP-SMap）和分子动力学模拟，我们发现IMB16-5与MICALL2的C端结构域结合。机制上，MICALL2阻止β-catenin与GSK3beta结合，从而保护β-catenin免于降解，最终促进Wnt信号传导。IMB16-5破坏MICALL2-β-catenin相互作用，抑制β-catenin核转位。因此，IMB16-5抑制HSCs中的糖酵解重编程和线粒体呼吸，促进静息表型。进一步研究表明，HIF-1alpha作用于MICALL2/β-catenin信号下游，整合代谢-炎症串扰。关键的是，体内MICALL2过表达消除了IMB16-5的治疗效果，确认了靶点结合。我们的工作确立了MICALL2作为肝纤维化的可成药靶点，并确定IMB16-5为通过双重代谢抑制发挥作用的潜在治疗候选药物。
